title: musik plugin manifest
$comment: Protocol v1. Unknown properties are kept. protocol is the exact string 1.

id.description: Stable plugin id. The describe command reports the same id.

executable.description: Executable path. Relative paths are resolved from the manifest file's directory. The host executes this path directly, with no shell.

capabilities.description: Protocol v1 runs library.import_url. library.search is optional and is invoked only when both sides list it. Other well-formed names are preserved and are not invoked.
